people.name: Narmer
people.role: First king of a united Egypt
people.why: Joined Upper and Lower Egypt under one crown around 3100 BC, the start of three thousand years of pharaohs.

stints.label: King of Upper and Lower Egypt

people.name: Imhotep
people.why: Designed the step pyramid of Djoser at Saqqara, the first great stone building; later worshipped as a god of healing.

people.name: Khufu
people.why: Built the Great Pyramid of Giza, the tallest building on Earth for nearly four thousand years.

people.name: Sargon of Akkad
people.why: Conquered the Sumerian cities and ruled from the Persian Gulf to Syria: the world's first known empire.

people.name: Hammurabi
people.why: United Mesopotamia and had 282 laws carved in stone, one of the earliest written law codes.

people.name: Hatshepsut
people.why: One of the few women to rule Egypt as pharaoh; sent trading fleets to Punt and built the temple at Deir el-Bahari.

people.name: Thutmose III
people.why: Egypt's greatest warrior pharaoh: won at Megiddo and pushed the empire to the Euphrates.

people.name: Suppiluliuma I
people.why: Made the Hittites a great power, conquering Mitanni and taking Syria from Egypt.

people.name: Akhenaten
people.why: Abolished Egypt's old gods for the worship of the sun disc Aten and built a new capital at Amarna.

people.name: Nefertiti
people.why: Akhenaten's queen and partner in his sun cult, famous for her painted bust.

people.name: Tutankhamun
people.why: Boy king who restored the old gods; his intact tomb, found in 1922, is the richest ever discovered.

people.name: Ramesses II
people.why: Fought the Hittites at Kadesh, signed the first known peace treaty and built Abu Simbel over a 66-year reign.

people.name: Moses
people.why: In Hebrew tradition, led the Israelites out of slavery in Egypt and received the Ten Commandments on Mount Sinai.

people.name: David
people.why: In the Hebrew Bible, the shepherd who slew Goliath and made Jerusalem the capital of a united Israel.

people.name: Solomon
people.why: David's son, remembered for his wisdom and for building the First Temple in Jerusalem.

stints.label: King of Israel, builds the Temple

people.name: Tiglath-Pileser III
people.why: Reorganised the Assyrian army into a standing force and conquered Syria, Israel and Babylon.

people.name: Sennacherib
people.why: Besieged Jerusalem, destroyed Babylon and made Nineveh a magnificent capital.

people.name: Ashurbanipal
people.why: Last great king of Assyria; conquered Egypt and Elam and gathered the clay-tablet library of Nineveh.

people.name: Piye
people.role: King of Kush, pharaoh of Egypt
people.why: Kushite king from Nubia who marched north and conquered Egypt, founding its 25th dynasty.

people.name: Nebuchadnezzar II
people.why: Destroyed Jerusalem and its Temple, exiled the Jews to Babylon and built the Ishtar Gate.

people.name: Croesus
people.why: Proverbially rich king who minted the first gold coins and lost his kingdom to Cyrus.

people.name: Cyrus the Great
people.why: Conquered Media, Lydia and Babylon, freed the Jewish exiles and built the largest empire the world had yet seen.

people.name: Cambyses II
people.why: Cyrus's son, who conquered Egypt in 525 BC.

people.name: Darius I
people.why: Organised the Persian Empire into satrapies, built Persepolis and the Royal Road, and sent the army that lost at Marathon.

people.name: Xerxes I
people.why: Invaded Greece with a vast army, won at Thermopylae and burned Athens, then lost his fleet at Salamis.

people.name: Darius III
people.why: Lost his empire to Alexander at Issus and Gaugamela and was murdered by his own satrap.

people.name: Ptolemy I Soter
people.why: Took Egypt after Alexander's death, founded the Ptolemaic dynasty and the Library of Alexandria.

people.name: Seleucus I Nicator
people.why: Won the largest share of Alexander's empire, from Syria to the Indus, and founded Antioch.

people.name: Antiochus III the Great
people.why: Rebuilt the Seleucid empire on a march to India, then lost to Rome at Magnesia.

people.name: Mithridates VI
people.why: Rome's most stubborn enemy in the east: ordered the massacre of Romans in Asia and fought three wars against Rome.

people.name: Cleopatra
people.why: Allied with Caesar and then Mark Antony to save Egypt's independence; her suicide made Egypt a Roman province.

people.name: Herod the Great
people.why: Rome's client king of Judea, who rebuilt the Temple in Jerusalem on a grand scale.

people.name: Solon
people.why: Cancelled debts, freed debt slaves and gave Athens laws that laid the ground for democracy.

people.name: Pythagoras
people.why: Founded a brotherhood at Croton that taught that the world is ordered by number.

people.name: Leonidas I
people.why: Held the pass of Thermopylae against the Persian army with 300 Spartans and died there.

people.name: Themistocles
people.why: Built Athens's fleet and lured the Persian navy into defeat at Salamis.

stints.label: Leader of Athens, victor of Salamis

people.name: Pericles
people.why: Led Athens at its height: democracy, the Parthenon and the Delian empire, until the plague killed him.

people.name: Herodotus
people.why: 'The father of history': travelled the Persian world and wrote the story of the Greek-Persian wars.

people.name: Socrates
people.why: Questioned everything in the streets of Athens and was condemned to death for it; the founder of Western philosophy.

people.name: Thucydides
people.why: Wrote the history of the Peloponnesian War as cold political analysis.

people.name: Alcibiades
people.why: Brilliant and faithless: led the Sicilian expedition, defected to Sparta, then to Persia, then back to Athens.

people.name: Lysander
people.why: Destroyed Athens's fleet at Aegospotami and ended the Peloponnesian War.

people.name: Plato
people.why: Socrates's student; founded the Academy in Athens and wrote the Republic.

people.name: Epaminondas
people.why: Broke Spartan power at Leuctra with a new oblique battle line and freed the helots of Messenia.

people.name: Philip II of Macedon
people.why: Built the Macedonian phalanx, beat Athens and Thebes at Chaeronea and made Greece follow Macedon.

people.name: Demosthenes
people.why: Roused Athens against Philip of Macedon in fiery speeches, the Philippics.

people.name: Aristotle
people.why: Plato's pupil and Alexander's tutor; wrote on logic, biology, politics and ethics and founded the Lyceum.

people.name: Diogenes
people.why: Lived in a jar in the marketplace to show how little a person needs.

people.name: Alexander the Great
people.role: King of Macedon, conqueror of Persia
people.why: Conquered the Persian Empire from Egypt to India in eleven years without losing a battle, spreading Greek culture across Asia.

people.name: Euclid
people.why: Wrote the Elements in Alexandria, the textbook of geometry for two thousand years.

people.name: Archimedes
people.why: The ancient world's greatest mathematician; his machines held off the Roman siege of Syracuse.

people.name: Eratosthenes
people.why: Librarian of Alexandria who measured the Earth's circumference with shadows.

people.name: Pyrrhus of Epirus
people.why: Beat Rome twice at a cost so heavy it gave us 'Pyrrhic victory'.

people.name: Hamilcar Barca
people.why: Fought Rome in Sicily, then won Carthage a new empire in Spain; Hannibal's father.

people.name: Hannibal
people.why: Crossed the Alps with elephants and destroyed Roman armies at Trebia, Trasimene and Cannae before losing at Zama.

people.name: Scipio Africanus
people.why: Took Spain from Carthage and beat Hannibal at Zama, ending the Second Punic War.

people.name: Cato the Elder
people.why: Stern guardian of old Roman ways who ended every speech with 'Carthage must be destroyed'.

people.name: Scipio Aemilianus
people.why: Destroyed Carthage in 146 BC and Numantia in 133 BC.

people.name: Tiberius Gracchus
people.why: Tried to give public land to Rome's poor and was clubbed to death by senators.

people.name: Gaius Gracchus
people.why: Took up his brother's land reform and cheap grain for the poor, and died like him in political violence.

people.name: Gaius Marius
people.role: Roman general and seven times consul
people.why: Opened the legions to the landless poor, beat Jugurtha and the invading Cimbri and Teutones, and fought Sulla.

people.name: Sulla
people.why: First Roman to march on Rome with his army; won the civil war and ruled as dictator.

people.name: Spartacus
people.why: Led a slave army of up to 70,000 that beat several Roman armies and roamed Italy for two years.

people.name: Pompey
people.role: Roman general, member of the First Triumvirate
people.why: Rome's greatest general before Caesar: cleared the seas of pirates, conquered the east, then lost the civil war to Caesar.

stints.label: Pirates and the conquest of the east

people.name: Marcus Licinius Crassus
people.role: Richest man in Rome, member of the First Triumvirate
people.why: Crushed the revolt of Spartacus, bankrolled Caesar, and died leading an army against Parthia at Carrhae.

people.name: Cicero
people.why: Rome's greatest orator: saved the Republic from Catiline's plot, defended it against Antony, and was murdered for it.

people.name: Cato the Younger
people.why: The Republic's most stubborn defender, who killed himself at Utica rather than live under Caesar.

people.name: Julius Caesar
people.why: Conquered Gaul, crossed the Rubicon, beat Pompey in civil war and made himself dictator for life before his murder.

people.name: Vercingetorix
people.role: Chief of the Arverni, leader of the Gauls
people.why: United the Gauls against Caesar, won at Gergovia, and surrendered at Alesia after a famous siege.

people.name: Marcus Junius Brutus
people.why: Led the plot to kill Caesar in the name of the Republic, and died after losing at Philippi.

stints.label: From the Ides of March to Philippi

people.name: Mark Antony
people.role: Roman general, member of the Second Triumvirate
people.why: Caesar's lieutenant who ruled the east as triumvir with Cleopatra and lost everything to Octavian at Actium.

stints.label: Triumvir in the east, with Cleopatra
Actium and the fall of Alexandria

people.name: Marcus Aemilius Lepidus
people.why: The third and weakest triumvir with Antony and Octavian; given Africa, he was pushed aside in 36 BC.

people.name: Augustus
people.why: Caesar's heir: won the civil wars, ended the Republic and ruled as Rome's first emperor, opening two centuries of Pax Romana.

people.name: Virgil
people.why: Wrote the Aeneid, Rome's national epic of its founding.

people.name: Mahavira
people.role: Founder of Jainism as it is known today
people.why: The 24th Jain tirthankara: taught non-violence to all living things and the path of the soul's liberation.

people.name: Gautama Buddha
people.why: A prince who gave up his palace to seek the end of suffering; enlightened under the Bodhi tree, he taught for 45 years.

people.name: Chandragupta Maurya
people.why: Overthrew the Nanda kings, drove out Alexander's garrisons and united most of India.

people.name: Chanakya
people.role: Indian statesman and author of the Arthashastra
people.why: Chandragupta's adviser, credited with the Arthashastra, a ruthless handbook of statecraft.

people.name: Porus
people.why: Fought Alexander at the Hydaspes with war elephants and so impressed him that he kept his kingdom.

people.name: Ashoka
people.why: Conquered Kalinga, was horrified by the slaughter, embraced Buddhism and carved edicts of peace across India.

people.name: King Wu of Zhou
people.why: Overthrew the last Shang king at Muye and founded the Zhou, the longest dynasty in Chinese history.

people.name: Duke of Zhou
people.why: Regent for the boy king Cheng; crushed a great rebellion and was revered by Confucius as the model statesman.

people.name: Laozi
people.why: Traditionally the author of the Tao Te Ching, the root text of Taoism; said to have left China riding west on an ox.

people.name: Sun Tzu
people.why: Credited with The Art of War, the most famous book of strategy ever written.

people.name: Confucius
people.why: Taught duty, learning and good government; his sayings shaped China, Korea and Japan for two thousand years.

people.name: Mencius
people.why: Taught that people are born good and that a ruler who oppresses them loses Heaven's mandate.

people.name: Shang Yang
people.why: His harsh laws and reforms made Qin the strongest of the warring states.

people.name: Bai Qi
people.why: Qin's most feared general, said to have killed 400,000 surrendered Zhao soldiers after Changping.

people.name: Qin Shi Huang
people.why: Conquered the six rival kingdoms, unified China in 221 BC, standardised its script and began the Great Wall.

people.name: Xiang Yu
people.why: Destroyed the Qin army and burned its capital, then lost the war for China to Liu Bang.

stints.label: Fall of Qin and war with Han

people.name: Emperor Gaozu of Han
people.why: Peasant-born rebel Liu Bang, who beat Xiang Yu and founded the Han dynasty.

people.name: Modu Chanyu
people.why: Forged the Xiongnu steppe empire and forced the Han to pay tribute.

people.name: Emperor Wu of Han
people.why: Pushed back the Xiongnu, opened the Silk Road and made Confucianism the creed of the state.

people.name: Zhang Qian
people.why: His journey to Central Asia, with ten years as a Xiongnu captive, opened the Silk Road.

people.name: Sima Qian
people.why: Wrote the Records of the Grand Historian, the model for all later Chinese histories.

people.name: Jesus
people.why: Jewish preacher from Galilee whose teaching, crucifixion and reported resurrection became the faith of a third of humanity.

people.name: Arminius
people.why: Trained as a Roman officer, he led three legions into ambush in the Teutoburg Forest and kept Rome out of Germany.

people.name: Tiberius
people.why: Augustus's stepson and heir, a gloomy and able ruler who spent his last years on Capri.

people.name: Saint Peter
people.why: Fisherman of Galilee who became the leader of the apostles; Catholics count him the first pope.

people.name: Paul the Apostle
people.why: Persecutor turned apostle whose journeys and letters carried Christianity to the Greek and Roman world.

people.name: Claudius
people.why: Scholarly emperor, mocked for his stammer, who conquered Britain.

people.name: Nero
people.why: Murdered his mother, sang while Rome burned in 64, blamed the Christians and died by suicide when the army turned on him.

people.name: Boudica
people.why: Led the Britons in revolt against Rome and burned Colchester, London and St Albans before her defeat.

people.name: Vespasian
people.why: Crushed the Jewish revolt, won the civil war of 69 and built the Colosseum.

people.name: Titus
people.why: Captured Jerusalem and destroyed the Second Temple in 70; as emperor he faced the eruption of Vesuvius.

people.name: Trajan
people.why: Conquered Dacia and Mesopotamia, bringing the Roman Empire to its greatest size.

people.name: Hadrian
people.why: Gave up conquest, built his wall across Britain and spent half his reign touring the provinces.

people.name: Bar Kokhba
people.role: Leader of the last Jewish revolt
people.why: Ruled an independent Judea for three years until Rome crushed the revolt and barred Jews from Jerusalem.

people.name: Ptolemy
people.why: His Almagest, with the Earth at the centre of the universe, guided astronomy for 1,400 years.

people.name: Marcus Aurelius
people.why: The philosopher-emperor: fought the Germans on the Danube for years and wrote the Meditations in camp.

people.name: Galen
people.why: Physician to emperors whose medicine was taught in Europe and the Islamic world until the 1600s.

people.name: Septimius Severus
people.why: African-born emperor who sacked Ctesiphon and died campaigning in Scotland at York.

people.name: Ardashir I
people.why: Overthrew the Parthians in 224 and founded Persia's Sasanian dynasty.

people.name: Shapur I
people.why: Beat three Roman emperors and took Emperor Valerian prisoner at Edessa.

people.name: Mani
people.why: Prophet who taught a cosmic war of light and darkness; his religion spread from Rome to China.

people.name: Zenobia
people.why: Broke away from Rome and conquered Egypt and Anatolia before Aurelian brought her to Rome in chains.

people.name: Aurelian
people.why: Reunited the broken empire, beat Zenobia and built Rome's Aurelian walls.

people.name: Diocletian
people.why: Split the empire among four emperors, reformed the army and taxes, and launched the last great persecution of Christians.

people.name: Constantine the Great
people.why: First Christian emperor: won at the Milvian Bridge, legalised Christianity and founded Constantinople.

people.name: Arius
people.why: Taught that the Son was made by the Father; condemned at Nicaea, but his Arian creed converted the Goths.

people.name: Athanasius of Alexandria
people.why: Champion of the Nicene Creed against Arianism, exiled five times.

people.name: Shapur II
people.why: Crowned before birth, he ruled seventy years and beat the Roman invasion of Julian.

people.name: Ezana of Axum
people.why: Made Aksum, in Ethiopia, one of the first Christian kingdoms in the world.

people.name: Julian
people.why: The last pagan emperor, who tried to undo Christianity and died invading Persia.

people.name: Theodosius I
people.why: Made Nicene Christianity the religion of the empire and was the last emperor to rule both halves.

people.name: Ambrose
people.why: Made Emperor Theodosius do penance for a massacre, and baptised Augustine.

people.name: Jerome
people.why: Translated the Bible into Latin, the Vulgate, in a cave at Bethlehem.

people.name: Augustine of Hippo
people.why: Wrote the Confessions and the City of God and shaped Western Christianity's ideas of sin and grace.

people.name: Hypatia
people.why: Taught philosophy and mathematics in Alexandria until a Christian mob murdered her.

people.name: Stilicho
people.why: Half-Vandal general who defended the West against Alaric until the emperor had him executed.

people.name: Alaric I
people.why: Led the Visigoths through the Balkans and Italy and sacked Rome in 410, the first time in 800 years.

stints.label: Wanderings and the sack of Rome

people.name: Saint Patrick
people.why: A Briton enslaved in Ireland who escaped, then returned as a bishop and converted the Irish.

people.name: Attila
people.why: 'The Scourge of God': ruled from the Rhine to the Caspian, ravaged the Balkans, Gaul and Italy.

people.name: Flavius Aetius
people.why: 'The last of the Romans': held Gaul for the West and stopped Attila at the Catalaunian Plains.

people.name: Pope Leo I
people.why: Met Attila on the Mincio and persuaded him to turn back from Rome.

people.name: Gaiseric
people.why: Led the Vandals into Africa, took Carthage and sacked Rome in 455.

people.name: Odoacer
people.why: German general who deposed the last western emperor, Romulus Augustulus, in 476.

people.name: Theodoric the Great
people.why: Took Italy from Odoacer and ruled Goths and Romans together in peace from Ravenna.

people.name: Clovis I
people.why: United the Franks, became a Catholic and founded the Frankish kingdom that became France.

people.name: Benedict of Nursia
people.why: Wrote the Rule of Saint Benedict, the pattern for monastic life in Europe, at Monte Cassino.

people.name: Justinian I
people.why: Reconquered Africa and Italy, rewrote Roman law and built the Hagia Sophia.

people.name: Theodora
people.why: Actress turned empress, who stiffened Justinian's nerve during the Nika riots.

people.name: Belisarius
people.why: Justinian's great general: beat Persia at Dara, took back Africa from the Vandals and Italy from the Goths.

people.name: Khosrow I
people.why: Persia's most admired king: reformed taxes, sacked Antioch and welcomed scholars to his court.

people.name: Aryabhata
people.why: Used zero as a place-holder, calculated pi closely and taught that the Earth spins on its axis.

people.name: Gregory the Great
people.why: Monk turned pope who fed Rome through plague and famine and sent missionaries to the English.

people.name: Khosrow II
people.why: Conquered Jerusalem and Egypt from Byzantium, then lost everything to Heraclius and was killed by his son.

people.name: Heraclius
people.why: Saved the empire from Persia with a daring march to Nineveh, then lost Syria and Egypt to the Arabs.

stints.label: Returns the True Cross to Jerusalem

people.name: Wang Mang
people.why: Seized the Han throne, tried sweeping land reforms and was killed when the Red Eyebrows revolt overran China.

people.name: Emperor Guangwu of Han
people.why: Restored the Han dynasty after Wang Mang and moved the capital to Luoyang.

people.name: Ban Chao
people.why: Spent thirty years in the Tarim Basin bringing the oasis kingdoms under Han rule.

people.name: Cai Lun
people.why: Credited with inventing paper from bark, rags and fishing nets around AD 105.

people.name: Kanishka
people.why: Ruled from Central Asia to the Ganges and championed Buddhism along the Silk Road.

people.name: Himiko
people.why: Shaman queen of Japan who sent envoys to China; the first Japanese ruler named in writing.

people.name: Cao Cao
people.role: Chancellor of Han, founder of Wei
people.why: Reunited northern China in the chaos of the late Han, but was stopped at the Red Cliffs.

people.name: Liu Bei
people.why: Wandering warlord who allied with Wu at the Red Cliffs and founded the kingdom of Shu.

stints.label: Red Cliffs and the conquest of Shu

people.name: Zhuge Liang
people.why: China's model of the wise strategist: Liu Bei's chancellor, he led five campaigns north against Wei.

people.name: Sun Quan
people.why: Held southern China at the Red Cliffs and founded Wu, the third of the Three Kingdoms.

people.name: Emperor Wu of Jin
people.why: Sima Yan took the throne of Wei, conquered Wu and reunited China in 280.

people.name: Samudragupta
people.why: Conquered much of India and began the Gupta golden age.

people.name: Chandragupta II
people.why: Ruled India's golden age of art, science and Sanskrit poetry.

people.name: Kalidasa
people.why: India's greatest classical poet, author of the play Shakuntala.

people.name: Gwanggaeto the Great
people.why: Made Goguryeo the master of Manchuria and northern Korea.

people.name: Siyaj Kʼakʼ
people.why: Arrived at the Maya city of Tikal from Teotihuacan in 378, the same day its king died, and set up a new dynasty.

people.name: Faxian
people.why: Walked from China to India to fetch Buddhist scriptures and sailed home by way of Sri Lanka and Java.

people.name: Kumārajīva
people.why: Kuchean monk whose Chinese translations of the sutras are still read today.

people.name: Emperor Xiaowen of Northern Wei
people.why: Moved his capital to Luoyang and made his nomad Xianbei court adopt Chinese dress, language and names.

people.name: Emperor Wen of Sui
people.why: Reunited China in 589 after nearly 300 years of division.

people.name: Emperor Yang of Sui
people.why: Built the Grand Canal and lost three disastrous wars in Korea that brought down his dynasty.

people.name: Prince Shōtoku
people.why: Spread Buddhism, wrote Japan's Seventeen-Article Constitution and opened relations with China.

people.name: Harsha
people.why: Last great Buddhist emperor of northern India, praised by the pilgrim Xuanzang.

people.name: Xuanzang
people.why: Walked from China to India and back over sixteen years and brought home hundreds of Buddhist texts.

people.name: Yazdegerd III
people.why: Lost Persia to the Arab armies at Qadisiyya and Nahavand and was murdered in flight at Merv.

people.name: Kʼinich Janaab Pakal
people.why: Ruled the Maya city of Palenque for 68 years; his jade-masked tomb lies in the Temple of the Inscriptions.

people.name: Muhammad
people.why: Received the revelations of the Quran in Mecca, founded the first Muslim community at Medina and united Arabia.

people.name: Abu Bakr
people.why: Muhammad's father-in-law and successor, who held Arabia together and launched the conquests of Iraq and Syria.

people.name: Khalid ibn al-Walid
people.why: 'The Sword of God': never lost a battle; conquered Iraq and beat the Byzantines at the Yarmouk.

people.name: Umar
people.why: Under him the Arabs took Syria, Egypt, Iraq and Persia; he entered Jerusalem in 637.

people.name: Uthman
people.why: Had the Quran written down in one standard text; his murder began the first Muslim civil war.

people.name: Ali
people.why: Muhammad's cousin and son-in-law; Shia Muslims hold he was the rightful successor. Murdered at Kufa.

people.name: Muawiya I
people.why: Governor of Syria who won the civil war against Ali and made the caliphate a dynasty ruled from Damascus.

people.name: Husayn ibn Ali
people.role: Grandson of Muhammad, third Shia imam
people.why: Killed with his family at Karbala by an Umayyad army, a martyrdom Shia Muslims mourn every year at Ashura.

people.name: Abd al-Malik
people.why: Built the Dome of the Rock and made Arabic the language of government.

people.name: Tariq ibn Ziyad
people.why: Crossed to Spain in 711, giving Gibraltar its name, and destroyed the Visigothic kingdom.

people.name: Musa ibn Nusayr
people.why: Completed the conquest of North Africa and followed Tariq into Spain.

people.name: Abd al-Rahman I
people.role: Founder of the Emirate of Córdoba
people.why: Last survivor of the massacred Umayyad family, he fled to Spain and founded a rival Muslim state there.

people.name: Al-Mansur
people.why: Founded Baghdad in 762, the round city that became the largest in the world.

people.name: Harun al-Rashid
people.why: Ruled Baghdad at the height of its glory, the caliph of the Thousand and One Nights.

people.name: Al-Ma'mun
people.why: Patron of the House of Wisdom, where Greek science was translated into Arabic.

people.name: Al-Khwarizmi
people.why: His books gave us algebra, and his name gave us the word 'algorithm'.

stints.label: Scholar at the House of Wisdom

people.name: Abd al-Rahman III
people.why: Declared himself caliph in 929; under him Córdoba was the richest city in Europe.

people.name: Ferdowsi
people.why: Spent thirty years writing the Shahnameh, Iran's national epic.

people.name: Mahmud of Ghazni
people.why: Raided India seventeen times and looted the temple of Somnath to build a glittering court at Ghazni.

people.name: Al-Biruni
people.why: Measured the Earth's radius and wrote the first great study of India and its religions.

stints.label: Scholar at the court of Ghazni

people.name: Avicenna
people.why: His Canon of Medicine was the standard medical textbook in Europe and the Islamic world for 600 years.

people.name: Alp Arslan
people.why: Destroyed the Byzantine army at Manzikert in 1071, opening Anatolia to the Turks.

people.name: Nizam al-Mulk
people.why: Ran the Seljuk empire for thirty years and founded the Nizamiyya colleges; murdered by the Assassins.

people.name: Omar Khayyam
people.why: Reformed the calendar, solved cubic equations and wrote the quatrains of the Rubaiyat.

people.name: Hasan-i Sabbah
people.role: Founder of the Nizari Ismaili state
people.why: Took the castle of Alamut and led the sect the crusaders called the Assassins.

people.name: Al-Ghazali
people.why: Left his chair at Baghdad to live as a wandering Sufi, and reconciled mysticism with Islamic law.

people.name: Yusuf ibn Tashfin
people.why: Founded Marrakesh and crossed into Spain to beat Castile at Sagrajas.

people.name: Averroes
people.why: Wrote the commentaries on Aristotle that revived Greek philosophy in Christian Europe.

people.name: Maimonides
people.why: Fled Córdoba, became physician to Saladin's court in Cairo and wrote the great codes of Jewish law and thought.

people.name: Saladin
people.why: United Egypt and Syria, destroyed the crusader army at Hattin and retook Jerusalem in 1187.

people.name: Rumi
people.why: His Masnavi is the most loved poem in Persian; his followers became the whirling dervishes.

people.name: Baybars
people.why: Beat the Mongols at Ain Jalut and spent his reign tearing down the crusader states.

people.name: Leo III the Isaurian
people.why: Beat the great Arab siege of Constantinople and began the ban on holy images.

people.name: Irene of Athens
people.why: Blinded her own son to rule alone, the first woman to reign over the empire in her own name.

people.name: Cyril and Methodius

people.name: Rurik

people.name: Vladimir the Great
people.why: Had himself and his people baptised in 988, making Rus' an Orthodox Christian land.

people.name: Basil II
people.why: 'The Bulgar-Slayer': destroyed the Bulgarian empire and left Byzantium at its medieval height.

people.name: Yaroslav the Wise
people.why: Gave Rus' its first written law and married his daughters to the kings of France, Hungary and Norway.

people.name: Michael I Cerularius
people.why: His clash with the pope's envoys in 1054 split the Catholic and Orthodox churches.

people.name: Alexios I Komnenos
people.why: Asked the West for help against the Turks, and got the First Crusade.

people.name: Anna Komnene
people.why: Wrote the Alexiad, her father's history and the first by a woman historian in Europe.

people.name: Charles Martel
people.why: Stopped the Arab advance into France at Tours in 732 and founded the Carolingian line.

people.name: Pepin the Short
people.why: Became king with the pope's blessing and gave the pope lands that became the Papal States.

people.name: Charlemagne

people.name: Pope Leo III
people.why: Crowned Charlemagne emperor in 800, founding the Western empire anew.

people.name: Alcuin
people.why: Ran Charlemagne's palace school and the revival of learning in the Frankish kingdom.

people.name: Alfred the Great
people.why: Held off the Vikings from a marsh at Athelney, beat them at Edington and laid the foundations of England.

people.name: Rollo
people.why: Viking leader granted Normandy by the French king in 911; William the Conqueror's ancestor.

people.name: Otto I
people.why: Smashed the Magyars at Lechfeld and was crowned emperor in Rome in 962, founding the Holy Roman Empire.

people.name: Erik the Red

people.name: Leif Erikson
people.why: Reached North America around 1000, five centuries before Columbus, and named it Vinland.

people.name: Stephen I of Hungary

people.name: Bolesław I the Brave

people.name: Cnut the Great

stints.label: King of England, Denmark and Norway

people.name: Harald Hardrada
people.why: Fought for Byzantium in the Varangian Guard, ruled Norway, and died invading England at Stamford Bridge.

people.name: Harold Godwinson
people.why: Beat Harald Hardrada at Stamford Bridge, then marched south and died at Hastings.

people.name: William the Conqueror

people.name: El Cid

people.name: Pope Gregory VII

people.name: Henry IV, Holy Roman Emperor

people.name: Pope Urban II

people.name: Godfrey of Bouillon

people.name: Hildegard of Bingen
people.why: Wrote visions, medicine and music and corresponded with popes and emperors.

people.name: Bernard of Clairvaux
people.why: The most powerful churchman of his age, who preached the Second Crusade.

people.name: Afonso I of Portugal

people.name: Eleanor of Aquitaine

people.name: Frederick Barbarossa

people.name: Henry II of England

people.name: Thomas Becket
people.why: Murdered in his cathedral by Henry II's knights in 1170; his shrine became England's great pilgrimage.

people.name: Philip II of France

people.name: Richard I of England

people.name: King John

people.name: Pope Innocent III

people.why: Gave up his wealth to live in poverty and preach; he even crossed the lines to preach to the sultan of Egypt.

people.name: Saint Dominic
people.why: Founded the order of preaching friars to win back the Cathars.

people.name: Alfonso VIII of Castile
people.why: Led the Christian kings to victory over the Almohads at Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212.

people.name: Frederick II, Holy Roman Emperor
people.role: Holy Roman Emperor and king of Sicily
people.why: 'The wonder of the world': spoke six languages, won back Jerusalem by treaty and was excommunicated four times.

people.name: Louis IX of France
people.why: Saint Louis: led two crusades, was captured in Egypt and died of disease before Tunis.

people.name: Thomas Aquinas
people.why: Joined Aristotle's philosophy to Christian faith in the Summa Theologica.

people.name: Simon de Montfort, 6th Earl of Leicester

people.wiki: Simon de Montfort, 6th Earl of Leicester

people.name: Edward I of England
people.why: Conquered Wales, hammered the Scots and shaped Parliament.

people.name: William Wallace

people.name: Robert the Bruce

people.name: Dante Alighieri
people.why: Wrote the Divine Comedy in exile from Florence, founding the Italian literary language.

people.name: Wu Zetian

people.name: Emperor Xuanzong of Tang

people.name: Li Bai

people.name: Du Fu
people.why: Wrote of the suffering of war and rebellion; often called China's greatest poet.

people.name: Gao Xianzhi

people.name: An Lushan
people.why: His rebellion, one of history's deadliest, broke the power of the Tang dynasty.

people.name: Adi Shankara

people.name: Emperor Kanmu

people.name: Kūkai
people.why: Brought esoteric Buddhism from China and founded the monastery on Mount Kōya.

people.name: Wang Geon
people.why: Reunited Korea under the Goryeo dynasty, which gave Korea its name.

people.name: Emperor Taizu of Song
people.why: General Zhao Kuangyin, who seized the throne and reunited China under scholar-officials instead of generals.

people.name: Murasaki Shikibu

stints.label: Writes The Tale of Genji at court

people.name: Fujiwara no Michinaga

people.name: Rajendra I

people.name: Anawrahta
people.why: United Burma for the first time and made it Theravada Buddhist.

people.name: Wang Anshi
people.why: Pushed through sweeping New Policies on farm loans, taxes and the army.

people.name: Emperor Huizong of Song
people.why: A brilliant painter and calligrapher who lost north China to the Jurchens and died their prisoner.

people.name: Suryavarman II
people.why: Built Angkor Wat, the largest religious monument in the world.

people.name: Yue Fei
people.why: Fought to win back north China from the Jin and was executed on false charges; a national hero.

people.name: Zhu Xi
people.why: His commentaries on the classics were the basis of the Chinese civil-service exams for 700 years.

people.name: Minamoto no Yoritomo

people.name: Minamoto no Yoshitsune

people.name: Prithviraj Chauhan
people.why: Beat Muhammad of Ghor at Tarain in 1191 but lost to him there the next year.

people.why: His victory at Tarain in 1192 opened northern India to Muslim rule.

people.name: Qutb ud-Din Aibak
people.why: A former slave who founded the Delhi Sultanate and began the Qutb Minar.

people.name: Razia Sultana
people.why: The only woman to rule the Delhi Sultanate.

people.name: Jayavarman VII
people.why: Drove out the Chams, made the Khmer empire Buddhist and built the Bayon temple with its stone faces.

people.name: Hōjō Tokimune
people.why: Led Japan against the Mongol invasions of 1274 and 1281.

people.name: Ram Khamhaeng
people.why: Credited with creating the Thai alphabet.

people.name: Sundiata Keita
people.why: The lion king of the Mande epic: beat the Sosso at Kirina and founded the Mali Empire.

people.name: Gebre Mesqel Lalibela
people.why: Had eleven churches carved down into the living rock as a new Jerusalem.

people.name: Eight Deer Jaguar Claw
people.why: Warlord whose conquests are painted in the Mixtec picture books.

people.name: Osman I
people.why: Turkish chief in north-west Anatolia whose small state grew into the Ottoman Empire.

people.name: Philip IV of France
people.why: 'The Fair': broke the Knights Templar and dragged the papacy to Avignon.

people.name: Mansa Musa
people.why: Perhaps the richest man who ever lived: his pilgrimage to Mecca spent so much gold that Cairo's prices crashed.

people.name: Giotto
people.why: Broke with flat medieval painting and gave figures weight and feeling, the first step to the Renaissance.

people.name: Petrarch
people.why: Hunted down lost Latin classics and wrote the love sonnets that founded Renaissance humanism.

people.name: Edward III of England
people.why: Claimed the French crown and began the Hundred Years War with victory at Crécy.

people.name: Edward the Black Prince
people.why: Captured the king of France at Poitiers in 1356.

people.name: Ibn Battuta
people.why: Travelled about 120,000 km over thirty years, from Mali to China, and dictated it all in his Rihla.

people.name: Murad I
people.why: Took Adrianople and the Balkans for the Ottomans and was killed at the Battle of Kosovo.

people.name: Timur

people.name: Bayezid I
people.why: 'The Thunderbolt': crushed the crusaders at Nicopolis, then was beaten and captured by Timur at Ankara.

people.name: Hongwu Emperor
people.why: A poor orphan and Red Turban rebel who drove out the Mongols and founded the Ming dynasty.

people.name: Yongle Emperor
people.why: Moved the capital to Beijing, built the Forbidden City and sent out Zheng He's treasure fleets.

people.name: Zheng He
people.why: Led seven treasure fleets of hundreds of ships across the Indian Ocean to Arabia and East Africa.

people.name: Jan Hus
people.why: Preached against church corruption a century before Luther and was burned at the Council of Constance.

people.name: Jan Žižka
people.why: One-eyed, then blind, general whose war wagons beat every crusade sent against the Hussites.

people.name: Władysław II Jagiełło
people.why: Grand Duke of Lithuania who married Poland's queen and broke the Teutonic Knights at Grunwald.

people.name: Henry the Navigator
people.why: Sent ship after ship down the African coast, starting Europe's age of exploration.

people.name: Henry V of England
people.why: Won the battle of Agincourt against a far larger French army and was made heir to France.

people.name: Joan of Arc

people.name: Charles VII of France
people.why: Crowned at Reims thanks to Joan of Arc; drove the English out of France.

people.name: Johannes Gutenberg
people.why: His movable-type printing press made books cheap and spread the Renaissance and the Reformation.

people.name: Sejong the Great
people.why: Created Hangul, the Korean alphabet, and sponsored inventions from rain gauges to water clocks.

people.name: Lê Lợi
people.why: Led ten years of war that drove the Ming out of Vietnam.

people.name: Filippo Brunelleschi
people.why: Built the great dome of Florence cathedral and worked out the rules of perspective.

people.name: John Hunyadi
people.why: Hungary's champion against the Ottomans, who held Belgrade against Mehmed II in 1456.

people.name: Skanderbeg
people.why: Deserted the Ottoman army and held Albania against it for 25 years from his castle at Krujë.

people.name: Constantine XI Palaiologos
people.why: Died fighting on the walls when Constantinople fell in 1453.

people.name: Mehmed II
people.why: Took Constantinople in 1453 with giant cannon, ending the Roman Empire, and made it the Ottoman capital.

people.name: Vlad the Impaler
people.why: Fought the Ottomans with such cruelty that he became the model for Dracula.

people.name: Nezahualcoyotl
people.why: Philosopher, poet and engineer king who co-founded the Aztec Triple Alliance.

people.name: Sunni Ali
people.why: Took Timbuktu and Djenné and built the Songhai Empire.

people.name: Lorenzo de' Medici
people.why: 'The Magnificent': patron of Botticelli and the young Michelangelo at the height of the Florentine Renaissance.

people.name: Sandro Botticelli
people.why: Painted The Birth of Venus and Primavera for the Medici circle.

people.name: Bartolomeu Dias

stints.label: Rounds the Cape of Good Hope

At the Spanish court, seeking backing
Third voyage, sent home in chains

people.name: Raphael

people.name: Ismail I

In Portugal's service in India and Malacca

people.name: Peter II of Russia

people.name: Casimir I the Restorer

people.name: Bolesław II the Generous

people.name: Władysław I Herman

people.name: Henry II the Pious

people.name: Władysław I the Elbow-high

people.name: John I Albert

people.name: Alexander Jagiellon

people.name: Michał Korybut Wiśniowiecki

people.name: Aleksander Kwaśniewski

people.name: Magnus Ladulås

people.name: Magnus IV of Sweden

people.name: Charles XV of Sweden

people.name: Gustaf VI Adolf

people.name: Tage Erlander

people.name: Magnus the Good

people.name: Sweyn II of Denmark

people.name: Canute IV of Denmark

people.name: Eric I of Denmark

people.name: Niels of Denmark

people.name: Canute VI of Denmark

people.name: Eric IV of Denmark

people.name: Eric VI of Denmark

people.name: Valdemar IV of Denmark

people.name: Eric of Pomerania

people.name: Christian I of Denmark

people.name: Frederick IV of Denmark

people.name: Christian VI of Denmark

people.name: Frederick V of Denmark

people.name: Frederick VII of Denmark

people.name: Frederick IX of Denmark

people.name: Béla III of Hungary

people.name: Ladislaus the Posthumous

people.name: Vladislaus II of Hungary

people.name: Ferenc Gyurcsány

people.name: Zoe Porphyrogenita

people.name: Nikephoros III Botaneiates

people.why: Army officer who read out the declaration of independence in 1971, later president, killed in a coup.

people.name: Sheikh Hasina
people.why: Daughter of the founder of Bangladesh, who ruled for twenty years until a student uprising drove her to India in 2024.

people.name: Muhammad Yunus
people.why: Banker to the poor and Nobel Peace Prize winner, who led Bangladesh after the fall of Sheikh Hasina.

people.name: Tarique Rahman
people.why: Son of Ziaur Rahman and Khaleda Zia, who returned from exile and won the election of February 2026.

people.name: Sirimavo Bandaranaike
people.why: The world's first woman prime minister, elected in Ceylon in 1960 after her husband was assassinated.

people.name: Mahinda Rajapaksa
people.why: President who ended the long civil war with the Tamil Tigers in 2009.

people.name: Timur Shah Durrani
people.why: Son of Ahmad Shah Durrani, who moved the capital to Kabul.

people.name: Dost Mohammad Khan
people.why: Emir driven out by the British invasion of 1839, who came back after their army was destroyed on the retreat from Kabul.

people.name: Shah Shuja Durrani
people.why: Put back on the throne by a British army in 1839 and murdered when it was destroyed.

people.name: Sher Ali Khan
people.why: Turned away a British mission in 1878 and fled when the British invaded again.

people.name: Abdur Rahman Khan
people.why: 'The Iron Emir', who forged a single Afghan state by force and agreed its border with British India.

people.name: Habibullah Khan
people.why: Kept Afghanistan neutral in the First World War and was shot dead on a hunting trip.

people.name: Amanullah Khan
people.why: Won Afghanistan's full independence from Britain in 1919, tried to modernise it at speed, and was driven out by a revolt.

people.name: Mohammed Zahir Shah
people.why: Last king of Afghanistan, who gave it forty years of peace and was overthrown by his cousin while abroad in 1973.

people.name: Mohammed Daoud Khan
people.why: Overthrew his cousin the king and was killed in the communist coup of 1978.

people.name: Mohammad Najibullah
people.why: Communist president who outlasted the Soviet withdrawal by three years and was hanged by the Taliban in 1996.

people.name: Mullah Omar
people.why: One-eyed cleric who founded the Taliban, ruled Afghanistan from Kandahar and sheltered Osama bin Laden.

people.name: Ashraf Ghani
people.why: Former World Bank economist who fled Kabul as the Taliban took it in August 2021.

people.name: Hibatullah Akhundzada
people.why: Reclusive cleric who rules Afghanistan from Kandahar and has banned girls from school beyond the age of twelve.

people.name: Hussein bin Ali, Sharif of Mecca
people.why: Guardian of Mecca who launched the Arab Revolt against the Ottomans in 1916, then lost his kingdom to Ibn Saud.
people.wiki: Hussein bin Ali, Sharif of Mecca

people.name: Faisal I of Iraq
people.why: Led the Arab Revolt beside Lawrence of Arabia from Arabia to Damascus, was crowned king of Syria, thrown out by the French, and made king of Iraq.

people.name: Faisal II of Iraq
people.why: Boy king of Iraq, killed with his family in the revolution of 1958.

people.name: Abd al-Karim Qasim
people.why: Officer who overthrew the monarchy in 1958 and was shot in a coup by the Baath party.

people.name: Nouri al-Maliki
people.why: Shia prime minister of Iraq through the civil war and the American withdrawal, until the rise of the Islamic State.

people.name: Abdullah I of Jordan
people.why: Son of the Sharif of Mecca, who founded Transjordan, took the West Bank in 1948 and was shot at the Al-Aqsa Mosque.

people.name: Hussein of Jordan
people.why: Survived dozens of plots to rule Jordan for 46 years, lost the West Bank in 1967 and made peace with Israel in 1994.

people.name: Abdullah II of Jordan
people.why: King of Jordan since 1999.

people.name: Faisal of Saudi Arabia
people.why: Modernising king who led the Arab oil embargo of 1973 and was shot by his nephew.

people.name: Fahd of Saudi Arabia
people.why: King who invited American troops in after Iraq invaded Kuwait in 1990.

people.name: Abdullah of Saudi Arabia
people.why: Cautious reformer who let women vote in local elections.

people.name: Salman of Saudi Arabia
people.why: King of Saudi Arabia, who handed the running of the country to his son Mohammed.

people.name: Levi Eshkol
people.why: Prime minister during the Six-Day War of 1967.

people.name: Menachem Begin
people.why: Former underground fighter who made peace with Egypt at Camp David and shared the Nobel Peace Prize with Sadat.

people.name: Shimon Peres
people.role: Prime minister and president of Israel
people.why: Founding father of Israel who shared the Nobel Peace Prize for the Oslo accords and was president in his eighties.

people.name: Ehud Olmert
people.why: Prime minister during the 2006 war in Lebanon, later jailed for corruption.

people.name: Emperor Zhenzong of Song
people.why: Bought peace from the Khitan Liao with a yearly gift of silver and silk in the treaty of Chanyuan of 1005.

people.name: Emperor Renzong of Song
people.why: Reigned 41 years, the longest of any Song emperor, while Song art and learning flowered and Bi Sheng invented movable type.

people.name: Emperor Yingzong of Song
people.why: Renzong's adopted heir, whose short reign was taken up by a quarrel over how to honour his real father.

people.name: Emperor Shenzong of Song
people.why: Backed Wang Anshi's sweeping New Policies to make the Song state rich and strong.

people.name: Emperor Zhezong of Song
people.why: Came to the throne at eight; his grandmother undid the reforms, and he brought them back once he ruled himself.

people.name: Emperor Qinzong of Song
people.why: Emperor for barely a year before the Jurchen took Kaifeng in 1127 and carried him and his father north; he died a prisoner.

people.name: Emperor Gaozong of Song
people.why: Escaped the fall of the north, founded the Southern Song at Hangzhou, and had the general Yue Fei put to death to make peace with the Jin.

people.name: Emperor Xiaozong of Song
people.why: Ablest of the Southern Song emperors, who cleared the name of Yue Fei and tried to win back the north.

people.name: Emperor Guangzong of Song
people.why: Mentally ill emperor, pushed off the throne by his own court in 1194.

people.name: Emperor Ningzong of Song
people.why: Weak emperor whose minister Han Tuozhou started a failed war against the Jin in 1206.

people.name: Emperor Lizong of Song
people.why: Joined the Mongols to destroy the Jin in 1234, then spent thirty years fighting the Mongols; he made Zhu Xi's teachings the state creed.

people.name: Jia Sidao
people.why: Cricket-loving chancellor who ran the Song state in its last years while the Mongols besieged Xiangyang, and was murdered after losing his army.

people.name: Wen Tianxiang
people.why: Scholar-general who fought on for the Song after Hangzhou fell and chose death rather than serve Kublai Khan; Chinese children still learn his poems.

people.name: Temür Khan
people.why: Kublai's grandson, who called off a third invasion of Japan and made peace with Vietnam.

people.name: Külüg Khan
people.why: Soldier emperor who spent so freely that he flooded the empire with new paper money.

people.name: Ayurbarwada
people.why: Confucian-schooled emperor who brought back the civil service examinations in 1315.

people.name: Gegeen Khan
people.why: Reforming young emperor murdered by his own officials in 1323.

people.name: Yesün Temür
people.why: Put on the throne by the plotters who killed Gegeen Khan, and then had them executed.

people.name: Tugh Temür
people.why: Won a civil war for the throne in 1328 and founded an academy of the arts and Confucian learning.

people.name: Toghon Temür
people.why: Last Mongol emperor of China, who fled Dadu as the Ming army came in 1368 and died on the steppe.

people.name: Jianwen Emperor
people.why: Hongwu's grandson, overthrown by his uncle, the future Yongle emperor; he vanished when his palace at Nanjing burned.

people.name: Xuande Emperor
people.why: Painter emperor who loved cricket fighting and sent Zheng He on the last of his great voyages.

people.name: Zhengtong Emperor
people.why: Led an army against the Mongols himself and was taken prisoner at Tumu in 1449; freed a year later, he won his throne back in a palace coup.

people.name: Jingtai Emperor
people.why: Took the throne when his brother was captured and saved Beijing from the Mongols, then was pushed aside when his brother came back.

people.name: Chenghua Emperor
people.why: Shy emperor devoted to Lady Wan, seventeen years his elder; the little 'chicken cups' made for him are some of the costliest porcelain on earth.

people.name: Hongzhi Emperor
people.why: Model Confucian ruler and the only Chinese emperor known to have had just one wife.

people.name: Zhengde Emperor
people.why: Pleasure-loving emperor who played at war and roamed in disguise while eunuchs ruled; the first Portuguese envoys reached China in his reign.

people.name: Jiajing Emperor
people.why: Survived an attempt by palace women to strangle him in 1542, then shut himself away seeking Daoist elixirs of immortality.

people.name: Longqing Emperor
people.why: Lifted the long ban on private sea trade, letting Spanish silver from the Americas flow into China.

people.name: Wanli Emperor
people.why: Reigned 48 years, sent armies to save Korea from Hideyoshi, then refused to meet his ministers for decades.

people.name: Zhang Juzheng
people.role: Senior Grand Secretary of Ming China
people.why: Ruled in the boy Wanli emperor's name and reformed the land tax so it was paid in silver.

stints.label: Senior Grand Secretary of Ming China

people.name: Tianqi Emperor
people.why: Spent his days at carpentry while the eunuch Wei Zhongxian terrorised the court.

people.name: Dorgon
people.why: Manchu prince who led the Qing armies through the Great Wall at Shanhai Pass in 1644, took Beijing, and ruled China as regent for his nephew.

stints.label: Through the Shanhai Pass to Beijing

people.name: Shunzhi Emperor
people.why: First Qing emperor to rule from Beijing, who took power at thirteen when Dorgon died, befriended the Jesuit Adam Schall and died of smallpox.

people.name: Yongzheng Emperor
people.why: Tireless emperor who read every report himself, set up the Grand Council and hid the name of his heir in a sealed box.

people.name: Jiaqing Emperor
people.why: Arrested his father's corrupt favourite Heshen, perhaps the richest man in the world, and fought the White Lotus rebels.

people.name: Daoguang Emperor
people.why: Ordered the opium trade stamped out and lost the Opium War to Britain, giving up Hong Kong in 1842.

people.name: Xianfeng Emperor
people.why: Reigned through the Taiping Rebellion and fled to Chengde when British and French troops took Beijing and burned the Summer Palace in 1860.

people.name: Tongzhi Emperor
people.why: Cixi's only son, emperor at five, who died of smallpox at eighteen.

people.name: Guangxu Emperor
people.why: Tried to modernise China in the Hundred Days' Reform of 1898, then was locked up by Cixi; he died of arsenic poisoning a day before her.

people.name: Li Hongzhang
people.why: China's leading statesman for thirty years, who fought the Taiping, built a modern navy, signed away Taiwan at Shimonoseki and toured the world in 1896.

stints.label: Peace talks after the Boxer Rising

people.name: Zeng Guofan
people.why: Confucian scholar who raised his own Hunan army and crushed the Taiping Rebellion, taking their capital Nanjing in 1864.

stints.label: The Xiang Army against the Taiping

people.name: Zuo Zongtang
people.why: General who won back the northwest and Xinjiang for China in 1867 to 1878; the American dish 'General Tso's chicken' is named after him.

stints.label: Reconquest of the northwest and Xinjiang

people.name: Hua Guofeng
people.role: Chairman of the Chinese Communist Party
people.why: Mao's chosen heir, who arrested the Gang of Four a month after Mao died and was soon pushed aside by Deng Xiaoping.

stints.label: Chairman of the Chinese Communist Party

people.name: Jiang Zemin
people.why: Shanghai party chief raised to the top after Tiananmen, who took back Hong Kong in 1997 and brought China into the World Trade Organization.

people.name: Hu Jintao
people.why: Engineer who led China through its fastest growth and the Beijing Olympics of 2008.

people.name: Chiang Ching-kuo
people.why: Chiang Kai-shek's Soviet-educated son, who ran Taiwan after his father and ended martial law in 1987.

people.name: Lee Teng-hui
people.why: 'Mr Democracy', the first Taiwan-born president, who won Taiwan's first direct presidential election in 1996.

people.name: Chen Shui-bian
people.why: First president from outside the Kuomintang, later jailed for corruption.

people.name: Ma Ying-jeou
people.why: Drew Taiwan closer to China and met Xi Jinping in Singapore in 2015, the first meeting of the two sides' leaders since 1949.

people.name: Tsai Ing-wen
people.why: Taiwan's first woman president, under whom it became the first place in Asia to allow same-sex marriage.

people.name: Lai Ching-te
people.why: Doctor turned politician, elected president of Taiwan in 2024.

people.name: Öz Beg Khan
people.why: Made Islam the faith of the Golden Horde, which reached its height under him; Ibn Battuta visited his travelling court.

people.name: Jani Beg
people.why: Besieged the Genoese port of Kaffa in 1346, where by one account his men catapulted plague corpses over the walls and the Black Death set sail for Europe.

people.name: Mamai
people.why: Warlord who ruled the western Golden Horde through puppet khans until Dmitry Donskoy beat him at Kulikovo in 1380.

people.name: Tokhtamysh
people.why: Reunited the Golden Horde with help from Timur, burned Moscow in 1382, then turned on Timur and lost everything.

people.name: Altan Khan
people.why: Mongol khan who raided to the walls of Beijing in 1550, founded the city of Hohhot and gave the leader of Tibetan Buddhism the title Dalai Lama.

stints.label: Raid to the walls of Beijing

people.name: 5th Dalai Lama
people.why: 'The Great Fifth', who united Tibet under the Dalai Lamas with Mongol help in 1642 and built the Potala Palace.

people.name: 13th Dalai Lama
people.why: Fled a British invasion in 1904 and a Chinese one in 1910, then came home and declared Tibet independent in 1913.

people.name: Bogd Khan
people.why: Tibetan-born head of Mongolia's Buddhists, made khan when Mongolia broke away from China in 1911.

people.name: Khorloogiin Choibalsan
people.why: 'Mongolia's Stalin', whose purges killed tens of thousands of monks and others.

people.name: Yumjaagiin Tsedenbal
people.why: Ruled communist Mongolia for over thirty years, until he was removed while on a visit to Moscow.

people.name: Fujiwara no Yorimichi
people.why: Michinaga's son, regent for fifty years, who built the Phoenix Hall of the Byōdō-in, the temple on Japan's 10-yen coin.

people.name: Emperor Go-Sanjō
people.why: First emperor in over a century whose mother was not a Fujiwara, who began to break their hold on the throne.

people.name: Emperor Shirakawa
people.why: Gave up the throne and ruled for forty more years as 'cloistered emperor'; only the river, the dice and the warrior monks would not obey him.

people.name: Emperor Toba
people.why: Ruled as cloistered emperor; the quarrel over his succession set the samurai clans fighting in 1156.

people.name: Emperor Go-Shirakawa
people.why: Wily cloistered emperor who played the Taira and Minamoto clans off against each other; Yoritomo called him Japan's greatest goblin.

people.name: Taira no Kiyomori
people.why: First samurai to rule Japan, who put his infant grandson on the throne; his clan's fall is the story of the Tale of the Heike.

people.name: Hōjō Masako
people.why: Yoritomo's widow, the 'nun shogun', who ran the shogunate after his death and rallied the samurai to crush the emperor's revolt of 1221.

people.name: Hōjō Yasutoki
people.why: Gave Japan its first samurai law code in 1232, which lasted for centuries.

people.name: Hōjō Tokiyori
people.why: Zen-loving regent who, legend says, roamed the country disguised as a monk to see how his people lived.

people.name: Hōjō Sadatoki
people.why: Tokimune's son, who ruled through the costly aftermath of the Mongol invasions and cancelled the samurai's debts in 1297.

people.name: Emperor Go-Daigo
people.why: Plotted to overthrow the shogunate, was exiled to the Oki islands, escaped and brought it down in 1333, then lost to Ashikaga Takauji and set up a rival court in the mountains.

people.name: Ashikaga Takauji
people.why: Samurai who turned on the Hōjō and then on Emperor Go-Daigo, and founded the Ashikaga shogunate in Kyoto.

people.name: Ashikaga Yoshiakira
people.why: Takauji's son, who spent his reign at war with the Southern Court.

people.name: Ashikaga Yoshimitsu
people.why: Ended the split between the two courts in 1392, built the Golden Pavilion, and accepted the title 'King of Japan' from the Ming.

people.name: Ashikaga Yoshimochi
people.why: Broke off his father's tribute trade with Ming China.

people.name: Ashikaga Yoshinori
people.why: Picked as shogun by drawing lots at a shrine; his harsh rule ended when a lord he threatened had him killed at a banquet.

people.name: Ashikaga Yoshimasa
people.why: Built the Silver Pavilion and loved tea and gardens, while the quarrel over his heir set off the Ōnin War that wrecked Kyoto.

people.name: Takeda Shingen
people.why: 'The Tiger of Kai', the most feared warlord of his day, who fought Uesugi Kenshin five times at Kawanakajima and died marching on Kyoto.

people.name: Uesugi Kenshin
people.why: 'The Dragon of Echigo', Shingen's great rival, who is said to have sent him salt when an enemy cut off his supply.

people.name: Ashikaga Yoshiaki
people.why: Last Ashikaga shogun, put in office by Oda Nobunaga in 1568 and driven out by him in 1573.

people.name: Tokugawa Hidetada
people.why: Ieyasu's son, who arrived too late for Sekigahara but took Osaka Castle in 1615 and made the Tokugawa peace secure.

people.name: Tokugawa Iemitsu
people.why: Closed Japan to the world, banned Christianity, crushed the Shimabara revolt and made the lords spend every other year in Edo.

people.name: Tokugawa Ietsuna
people.why: Shogun at ten; his reign saw the great fire of 1657 that burned most of Edo.

people.name: Tokugawa Tsunayoshi
people.why: 'The Dog Shogun', whose laws protecting animals made harming a dog a crime punished by death; the tale of the 47 rōnin happened in his reign.

people.name: Tokugawa Yoshimune
people.why: Thrifty reformer who put a suggestion box outside his castle and let Western books into Japan again in 1720.

people.name: Tokugawa Ieharu
people.why: Left the government to the bribe-taking minister Tanuma Okitsugu as famine swept Japan.

people.name: Tokugawa Ienari
people.why: Longest-serving shogun, who fathered over fifty children.

people.name: Tokugawa Ieyoshi
people.why: Died weeks after Commodore Perry's black ships sailed into Edo Bay in 1853.

people.name: Abe Masahiro
people.why: Opened Japan to American ships with the treaty of Kanagawa in 1854.

people.name: Ii Naosuke
people.why: Signed the treaty that opened Japan's ports to American trade without the emperor's consent and was cut down at a castle gate in the snow.

people.name: Tokugawa Iemochi
people.why: Married the emperor's sister to heal the rift between Edo and Kyoto, and died at twenty fighting rebels.

people.name: Tokugawa Yoshinobu
people.why: Last shogun, who handed power back to the emperor in 1867, lost the short war that followed, and spent his long retirement on photography and cycling.

people.name: Itō Hirobumi
people.why: Japan's first prime minister and author of its 1889 constitution, who was shot dead at Harbin by a Korean patriot after ruling Korea for Japan.

people.name: Emperor Taishō
people.why: Sickly emperor whose son Hirohito ruled for him from 1921.

people.name: Hara Takashi
people.why: Japan's first commoner prime minister, stabbed to death at Tokyo Station.

people.name: Shigeru Yoshida
people.why: Prime minister under the American occupation, who rebuilt Japan as a trading nation sheltering under American protection.

people.name: Eisaku Satō
people.why: Won back Okinawa from the United States and the Nobel Peace Prize for keeping Japan free of nuclear weapons.

people.name: Kakuei Tanaka
people.why: Self-made builder who restored ties with China in 1972 and fell in the Lockheed bribery scandal.

people.name: Yasuhiro Nakasone
people.why: Reagan's close ally, who sold off Japan's state railways.

people.name: Akihito
people.why: Emperor who travelled Asia to make peace with the memory of the war and became the first Japanese emperor to abdicate in two centuries.

people.name: Naruhito
people.why: Emperor of Japan since 2019, who studied river transport on the Thames at Oxford.

people.name: Junichiro Koizumi
people.why: Maverick reformer with a lion-mane haircut and a love of Elvis, who privatised the post office.

people.name: Shinzo Abe
people.why: Japan's longest-serving prime minister, known for 'Abenomics', shot dead while giving a speech in 2022.

people.name: Fumio Kishida
people.why: Prime minister from Hiroshima, who hosted the G7 summit there in 2023.

people.name: Shigeru Ishiba
people.why: Former defence minister, prime minister for a year.

people.name: Sanae Takaichi
people.why: Admirer of Margaret Thatcher who became Japan's first woman prime minister in 2025.

people.name: Hyeonjong of Goryeo
people.why: Fled his burning capital before a Khitan invasion and came back to beat them; the first carving of the Buddhist scriptures, the Tripitaka Koreana, began under him.

people.name: Gang Gam-chan
people.why: Old scholar-general who destroyed a Khitan army at Gwiju in 1019, ending their invasions of Korea.

people.name: Munjong of Goryeo
people.why: Reigned in the golden age of Goryeo, when its celadon pottery and Buddhist learning flourished.

people.name: Sukjong of Goryeo
people.why: Minted Korea's first coins.

people.name: Yejong of Goryeo
people.why: Sent an army to wall off the Jurchen in the north, then gave the land back.

people.name: Injong of Goryeo
people.why: Survived two great revolts and had Kim Busik write Korea's oldest surviving history.

people.name: Uijong of Goryeo
people.why: Pleasure-loving king overthrown by his own generals in 1170, which began a century of military rule.

people.name: Choe Chung-heon
people.why: General who seized power in 1196 and made kings and unmade them; his family ruled Korea for sixty years.

people.name: Gojong of Goryeo
people.why: Reigned as the Mongols ravaged Korea; his court held out on Ganghwa Island for decades and carved the 81,000 woodblocks of the Tripitaka Koreana.

people.name: Chungnyeol of Goryeo
people.why: Married Kublai Khan's daughter and sent Korean ships and men on the Mongol invasions of Japan.

people.name: Gongmin of Goryeo
people.why: Threw off Mongol rule in 1356 and was a fine painter; he was murdered in his palace.

people.name: Taejo of Joseon
people.why: General who turned his army around on an island in the Yalu instead of attacking Ming China, seized power, and founded the Joseon kingdom at Seoul.

stints.label: Turns his army back and seizes power

people.name: Taejong of Joseon
people.why: Killed his rivals and brothers on his way to the throne, then built the strong state that his son Sejong ruled.

people.name: Sejo of Joseon
people.why: Took the throne from his boy nephew and had him killed, then ruled as a strong reformer.

people.name: Seongjong of Joseon
people.why: Finished Korea's great law code and filled his court with Confucian scholars.

people.name: Yeonsangun of Joseon
people.why: Korea's worst tyrant, who purged the scholars and turned the national academy into a pleasure ground; he was overthrown in 1506.

people.name: Jungjong of Joseon
people.why: Put on the throne by the coup against his half-brother; his reformer Jo Gwang-jo was purged and poisoned.

people.name: Myeongjong of Joseon
people.why: Boy king whose mother ruled in his name.

people.name: Seonjo of Joseon
people.why: King who fled his capital to the Chinese border when Hideyoshi's armies invaded in 1592, and was saved by Ming troops and Admiral Yi's fleet.

people.name: Gwanghaegun of Joseon
people.why: Rebuilt Korea after the Japanese war and steered between the Ming and the Manchus, until a coup sent him into exile.

people.name: Injo of Joseon
people.why: Stood a siege in the mountain fortress of Namhansanseong, then knelt and bowed nine times to the Manchu emperor Hong Taiji in 1637.

people.name: Hyojong of Joseon
people.why: Spent eight years as a Manchu hostage in Shenyang, then as king planned a revenge march north that never came; Dutch sailors were shipwrecked in his reign.

people.name: Sukjong of Joseon
people.why: Reigned 46 years amid fierce court factions and the drama of his consort Jang Hui-bin.

people.name: Yeongjo of Joseon
people.why: Longest-reigning king of Korea, who tried to end the court feuds and had his own son locked in a rice chest to die.

people.name: Jeongjo of Joseon
people.why: Reforming king who founded a royal library and built the fortress of Hwaseong to honour his murdered father.

people.name: Sunjo of Joseon
people.why: Came to the throne at ten; Korea's first Catholics were massacred in the persecution of 1801.

people.name: Heungseon Daewongun
people.why: Regent for his son Gojong, who shut Korea to the West, fought off French and American raids, and rebuilt the great palace in Seoul.

people.name: Gojong of Korea
people.why: Last king of Joseon, who proclaimed the Korean Empire in 1897 and was forced to abdicate by Japan in 1907; his funeral sparked the protests of 1919.

people.name: Empress Myeongseong
people.why: Gojong's strong-willed queen, who led the court's resistance to Japan and was murdered in the palace by Japanese agents in 1895.

people.name: Sunjong of Korea
people.why: Last emperor of Korea, who signed nothing as Japan annexed his country in 1910.

people.name: Park Chung-hee
people.why: General who seized power in 1961 and turned South Korea into an industrial power, until his own spy chief shot him.

people.name: Chun Doo-hwan
people.why: General who took power after Park was killed and crushed the Gwangju uprising of 1980; later sentenced to death and pardoned.

people.name: Roh Tae-woo
people.why: Chun's fellow general, who allowed free elections, won them and hosted the Seoul Olympics.

people.name: Kim Young-sam
people.why: First civilian president in thirty years, who put his two predecessors on trial.

people.name: Kim Dae-jung
people.why: Democracy campaigner once kidnapped and nearly drowned by the regime, who as president reached out to the North and won the Nobel Peace Prize.

people.name: Roh Moo-hyun
people.why: Self-taught human-rights lawyer who became president.

people.name: Lee Myung-bak
people.why: Former Hyundai boss, later jailed for bribery.

people.name: Park Geun-hye
people.why: Park Chung-hee's daughter and South Korea's first woman president, impeached and removed in 2017.

people.name: Moon Jae-in
people.why: Held three summits with Kim Jong Un in 2018.

people.name: Yoon Suk Yeol
people.why: Former prosecutor who declared martial law in December 2024 and was impeached and removed from office.

people.name: Lee Jae-myung
people.why: Former factory child labourer who became president after Yoon's removal in 2025.

people.name: Lý Thái Tổ
people.why: Founded the Lý dynasty and moved the capital to Thăng Long, today Hanoi, in 1010.

people.name: Lý Thường Kiệt
people.why: Struck first into Song China in 1075 and stopped the Song counter-attack; the poem 'Mountains and Rivers of the Southern Country' is credited to him.

people.name: Lý Nhân Tông
people.why: Longest-reigning Vietnamese monarch, under whom the first national university opened in Hanoi.

people.name: Trần Thái Tông
people.why: First Trần emperor, who drove out the first Mongol invasion of Vietnam in 1258.

people.name: Trần Hưng Đạo
people.why: Beat the Mongols twice, in 1285 and 1288, finishing their fleet on iron-tipped stakes hidden in the Bạch Đằng River; Vietnam's greatest hero.

stints.label: The third invasion and Bạch Đằng

people.name: Lê Thánh Tông
people.why: Conquered the kingdom of Champa in 1471 and gave Vietnam the Hồng Đức law code.
