people.why: A farmer on Ganghwa Island, picked to be king because he had royal blood and would be easy to control.

people.name: Al-Ashraf Khalil
people.why: Took Acre in 1291 and swept the last crusaders out of the Holy Land; murdered by his emirs two years later.

people.name: Al-Ashraf Sha'ban
people.why: Boy sultan in whose reign crusaders from Cyprus sacked Alexandria in 1365; strangled by his own soldiers.

people.name: Jaqmaq
people.why: Pious old sultan who sent his fleets against the Knights of Rhodes.

people.name: Inal
people.why: Old soldier who became sultan in the year the Ottomans took Constantinople.

people.name: Khushqadam
people.why: Mamluk of Greek birth who rose to be sultan.

people.name: Tuman bay II
people.why: Last Mamluk sultan, who fought the Ottoman conqueror Selim to the end and was hanged at the Bab Zuwayla gate of Cairo.

people.name: Domenico Michiel
people.why: Led the Venetian Crusade that smashed an Egyptian fleet and helped take Tyre in 1124.

people.name: Vitale II Michiel
people.why: Murdered by a mob after his fleet, sent against Byzantium, came home with the plague.

people.name: Sebastiano Ziani
people.why: Richest man in Venice, who hosted the peace between Emperor Frederick Barbarossa and Pope Alexander III in 1177.

people.name: Pietro Ziani
people.why: Organised the empire of islands and ports that Venice won in the Fourth Crusade.

people.name: Ranieri Zeno
people.why: Fought Genoa in the War of Saint Sabas, the first of four great wars between the two sea republics.

people.name: Pietro Gradenigo
people.why: Closed the Great Council to new families in 1297, fixing Venice's ruling class for five hundred years.

people.name: Andrea Dandolo
people.why: Scholar doge and friend of Petrarch, who wrote a history of Venice and saw half the city die in the Black Death.

people.name: Marino Faliero
people.why: Beheaded for plotting to make himself prince; in the Doge's Palace his portrait is a painted black shroud.

people.name: Andrea Contarini
people.why: Old doge who led the fleet himself in the War of Chioggia, when Genoa nearly took Venice in 1380.

people.name: Michele Steno
people.why: Took Padua, Verona and Vicenza, beginning Venice's empire on the mainland.

people.name: Tommaso Mocenigo
people.why: Warned on his deathbed against war with Milan, and against electing Foscari, who would start one.

people.name: Cristoforo Moro
people.why: Doge in the long war with the Ottomans that cost Venice the island of Negroponte in 1470.

people.name: Agostino Barbarigo
people.why: Won Cyprus for Venice in 1489 and built the clock tower on St Mark's Square.

people.name: Andrea Gritti
people.why: Merchant and soldier who won back Padua in 1509 and, as doge, rebuilt St Mark's Square.

people.name: Sebastiano Venier
people.why: Commanded the Venetian fleet at Lepanto at the age of 75, and was made doge for it.

people.name: Leonardo Donà
people.why: Defied the pope's ban on Venice in 1606, and was shown Galileo's new telescope in 1609.

people.name: Francesco Morosini
people.why: Conquered the Peloponnese from the Ottomans; one of his shells blew up the Parthenon in 1687.

people.name: Pope Paschal II
people.why: Fought Emperor Henry V over who appoints bishops and was taken prisoner by him in 1111.

people.name: Pope Innocent II
people.why: Won a schism against a rival pope with the help of Bernard of Clairvaux.

people.name: Pope Eugene III
people.why: Monk and pupil of Bernard of Clairvaux who called the Second Crusade.

people.name: Pope Celestine III
people.why: Elected at 85, he crowned the Emperor Henry VI and spent seven years trying to keep him from swallowing Italy.

people.name: Pope Honorius III
people.why: Approved the new orders of St Dominic and St Francis and crowned Frederick II emperor.

people.name: Pope Alexander IV
people.why: Fought the heirs of Frederick II and made Clare of Assisi a saint.

people.name: Pope Urban IV
people.why: Cobbler's son from Troyes who created the feast of Corpus Christi and invited Charles of Anjou to take Sicily.

people.name: Pope Clement IV
people.why: French lawyer-pope who made Charles of Anjou king of Sicily; after his death the cardinals took three years to choose a successor.

people.name: Pope Nicholas III
people.why: Pope of the Orsini family, whom Dante put in hell for selling church offices.

people.name: Pope Martin IV
people.why: So devoted to Charles of Anjou that he excommunicated the Sicilians who rose against him; Dante put him in purgatory for gluttony.

people.name: Pope Nicholas IV
people.why: First Franciscan pope, who sent the friar John of Montecorvino as the first Catholic missionary to China.

people.name: Pope Benedict XII
people.why: Cistercian monk who began the great papal palace at Avignon.

people.name: Pope Clement VI
people.why: Lavish pope who bought Avignon, and protected the Jews when they were blamed for the Black Death.

people.name: Pope Innocent VI
people.why: Sent Cardinal Albornoz with an army to win back the Papal States in Italy.

people.name: Pope Urban V
people.why: Took the papacy back to Rome in 1367, but returned to Avignon three years later and died there.

people.name: Pope Boniface IX
people.why: Roman pope of the Great Schism, who sold indulgences on a grand scale.

people.name: Pope Innocent VII
people.why: Roman pope of the Great Schism, driven out of Rome by a riot in 1405.

people.name: Pope Gregory XII
people.why: Resigned in 1415 to end the Great Schism, the last pope to step down until Benedict XVI.

people.name: Pope Paul II
people.why: Venetian pope who built the Palazzo Venezia in Rome and staged lavish carnivals.

people.name: Pope Julius III
people.why: Reopened the Council of Trent, and scandalised Rome by making a teenage boy he had found in the streets a cardinal.

people.name: Pope Gregory XV
people.why: Set up the office that ran Catholic missions around the world, and made Ignatius of Loyola and Francis Xavier saints.

people.name: Pope Clement IX
people.why: Poet and opera librettist, pope when Venice lost Crete to the Ottomans in 1669.

people.name: Pope Clement X
people.why: Became pope at 79 and left the work to his cardinal nephew.

people.name: Pope Innocent XII
people.why: Forbade popes to make their relatives rich, ending centuries of papal nepotism.

people.name: Pope Benedict XIII
people.why: Friar who lived as a monk while his corrupt secretary ran Rome.

people.name: Pope Leo XII
people.why: Stern pope who forced the Jews of Rome back into their ghetto and policed the morals of the city.

people.name: Anund Jacob
people.why: Son of Olof Skötkonung, who fought Canute the Great at the Battle of Helgeå.

people.name: Emund the Old
people.why: Last king of the old royal house of Uppsala.

people.name: Stenkil
people.why: Founder of a new royal house, a Christian who stopped the missionaries from tearing down the pagan temple at Uppsala.

people.name: Inge the Elder
people.why: Christian king driven out for a time by pagans when he would not hold the sacrifices at Uppsala.

people.name: Sverker the Elder
people.why: Brought in the monks who founded Sweden's first monasteries, and was murdered on his way to church at Christmas.

people.name: Charles VII of Sweden
people.why: First to be called king of the Swedes and the Goths; killed by Knut Eriksson.

people.name: Knut Eriksson
people.why: Son of Saint Eric, who killed King Charles to take the throne and then ruled in peace for nearly thirty years.

people.name: Sverker the Younger
people.why: Lost his throne in battle at Lena in 1208 and died trying to win it back.

people.name: Eric X of Sweden
people.why: The first king of Sweden known to have been crowned.

people.name: John I of Sweden
people.why: Became king at fifteen and died at 21, the last of the house of Sverker.

people.name: Eric XI of Sweden
people.why: 'The Lisp and Lame', in whose name the great nobles ruled; the last of Saint Eric's line.

people.name: Valdemar Birgersson
people.why: Son of Birger Jarl, made king as a boy; deposed by his brother Magnus.

people.name: Birger Magnusson
people.why: Invited his brothers to a feast at Nyköping in 1317, threw them in the dungeon and let them starve; driven out the next year.

people.name: Albert of Mecklenburg
people.why: German prince put on the Swedish throne by the nobles, who lost it to Margaret of Denmark in 1389.

people.name: Władysław II the Exile
people.why: Eldest son of Bolesław III, driven out by his brothers when he tried to rule all of Poland.

people.name: Bolesław IV the Curly
people.why: Lost a war to Frederick Barbarossa in 1157 and had to kneel before him.

people.name: Casimir II the Just
people.why: Took Kraków from his brother Mieszko the Old and was remembered as 'the Just'.

people.name: Leszek the White
people.why: Murdered at a meeting of the Polish princes, leaving the country more divided than ever.

people.name: Henry the Bearded
people.why: Duke of Silesia and husband of Saint Hedwig, who came close to reuniting Poland.

people.name: Bolesław V the Chaste
people.why: Fled the Mongols twice and gave Kraków its town charter in 1257.

people.name: Leszek II the Black
people.why: Fled to Hungary when the Mongols invaded Poland for the third time in 1287.

people.name: Przemysł II
people.why: Crowned in 1295 as the first king of Poland in two centuries, and murdered seven months later.

people.name: Wenceslaus II of Bohemia
people.why: King of Bohemia, made rich by the silver mines of Kutná Hora, who was crowned king of Poland too in 1300.

people.name: Stephen II of Hungary
people.why: Warred with all his neighbours and lost most of the wars.

people.name: Béla II of Hungary
people.why: 'The Blind', blinded as a boy by his uncle King Coloman; his queen had the nobles who had backed it massacred.

people.name: Stephen III of Hungary
people.why: Fought off the Byzantine emperor Manuel, who tried to make Hungary a client state.

people.name: Emeric of Hungary
people.why: Lost the city of Zara to the Fourth Crusade, which Venice turned against it in 1202.

people.name: Michael Hainisch
people.why: First president of the Austrian republic.

people.name: Ignaz Seipel
people.why: Catholic priest who was twice chancellor and saved the currency with a loan from the League of Nations.

people.name: Wilhelm Miklas
people.why: President when Hitler took Austria in 1938, who held out longest against appointing a Nazi chancellor.

people.name: Leopold Figl
people.why: Survived Dachau to become postwar Austria's first chancellor; as foreign minister he signed the treaty that freed Austria in 1955.

people.name: Julius Raab
people.why: Negotiated the end of the four-power occupation in Moscow in 1955, in return for Austrian neutrality.

people.name: Alfons Gorbach
people.why: Another survivor of Dachau, chancellor for three years.

people.name: Josef Klaus
people.why: Led Austria's first one-party government after the war.

people.name: Fred Sinowatz
people.why: Chancellor when the Waldheim affair broke.

people.name: Franz Vranitzky
people.why: Banker who took Austria into the European Union in 1995 and admitted its share of guilt for the Holocaust.

people.name: Viktor Klima
people.why: Former oil company manager, chancellor for three years.

people.name: Wolfgang Schüssel
people.why: Brought the far-right Freedom Party into government in 2000, and the rest of the EU shunned Austria for months.

people.name: Werner Faymann
people.why: Chancellor in the refugee crisis of 2015.

people.name: Manuel de Arriaga
people.why: Lawyer elected the first president of the Portuguese republic, who resigned in 1915.

people.name: Bernardino Machado
people.why: Twice president and overthrown both times: by Sidónio Pais in 1917 and by the army in 1926.

people.name: António José de Almeida
people.why: The only president of the First Republic to finish his term.

people.name: Manuel Teixeira Gomes
people.why: Writer who gave up the presidency and spent his last years in Algeria.

people.name: Harold Harefoot
people.why: Son of Canute, who took England while his half-brother Harthacnut was away in Denmark.

people.name: Lord Durham
people.why: 'Radical Jack', sent to Canada after the rebellions of 1837, whose report urged self-government and the union of the two Canadas.

people.name: Louis-Joseph Papineau
people.why: Led the French-Canadian Patriotes, whose rising of 1837 was crushed; he fled to the United States and then to France.

people.name: John Gorton
people.why: Fighter pilot whose face was rebuilt after a crash in the war; he lost his party's vote of confidence with his own casting vote.

people.name: William McMahon
people.why: Lost to Gough Whitlam in 1972, ending 23 years of conservative rule.

people.name: José Figueroa Alcorta
people.why: The only Argentine to lead all three branches of government: the Senate, the presidency and the supreme court.

people.name: Ramón Castillo
people.why: Kept Argentina neutral in the Second World War until the army threw him out in 1943.

people.name: Eduardo Duhalde
people.why: Chosen by Congress to steer Argentina out of the crash of 2001; he cut the peso's tie to the dollar.
